item.title: Novo Nordisk Wegovy Pill Launch
item.description:
• Summary: Novo Nordisk's CEO hailed a record-breaking start for the oral formulation of Wegovy (semaglutide) in the U.S. market. The once-daily pill, approved for weight management, is expected to expand access and convenience for patients, potentially capturing a larger share of the obesity treatment market.
  • MoAs: Wegovy (semaglutide) - GLP-1 receptor agonist that stimulates insulin secretion, slows gastric emptying, and reduces appetite, leading to weight loss.
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology
